description.narrative: MASSIF has committed USD 10mln to the Fund at First Close. The Fund focuses on investments in Cambodia and Laos, where impact potential is high and the penetration of PE activities remains low. The investment will allow FMO to keep supporting a trusted partner active in countries where there are limited PE teams with on-the-ground presence and local knowledge.
